review.basis: Complete changed-clause semantic review against b28226e3f33068f0b50429a6856248cb22e7b0c3, APPLY-authorized PROP-01–06; no independent reviewer or installed-runtime assurance.
review.preservation: All 53 other complete contracts remain verbatim. Preserve eight admission contacts, existing routing, authority/failure semantics, peer checkpoints, R24 confinement and INSTALL-13/14.
review.formalization: Structured boundaries refer to complete semantic clauses. They do not decide semantic judgments or manufacture facts. Formal bootstrap guards are necessary checks, not sufficient authorization.
review.coreRationale: Precedence, authority, proportionality, language, consumer exclusions, state separation and evidence invariants apply across routes. Entry/context/workspace add current identity and availability; conditional business modules remain on demand.
review.dependencyRationale: Dependencies are conservative prerequisites from reviewed meaning. Effectful branches add action/security/execution facets even when a request initially seems informational. Context assembly never grants authority.
limitations: Semantic review performed by the producing AI; no independent human/second-model approval claimed.
No runtime adapter, provider enrollment or consumer installation executed by this package.

modules.purpose: Canonical precedence, governance, authority, language, evidence and portable continuity invariants.
Current-project private identity, protection, ownership and state isolation.
Scoped private hints, supersession and conflict-safe shared coordination.
Bindings, thin owned activation adapters and version-neutral global discovery.
Complete eligible administrative installation, frozen initial package and later-chat wrapper evolution.
Free-first selection and justified paid exceptions.
Provider-neutral scoped discovery, creation, canonical binding and access.
Project-authorized identity, controlled invocation, enrollment and separate access/signing proofs.
Organizational canonical representation, external sources of record and dependency graph.
Project canonical operations, foundational intake and publication.
Relevant repository inventory and retrieval.
Effective-scope discovery and proportionate clarification.
Effective scope, causal propagation and proportionate new organizational capabilities.
Managed work, transition guards, durability, notifications and completion.
Reviewable change sets, authorized desired state, application and verification.
Material cross-domain coordination during planning and authorized execution; no inferred authority.
Intended, attempted, observed, applied and verified effects; informed recovery/retry.
Shared organizational transformation, read/write compatibility, ownership and concurrency.
Optional OOP ancestry and rewrite-safe three-scope technical migration distribution.
Bounded source freshness, independent runtime checkpoints and optional ordered migration/current-state reconciliation.
Budget signals, reliable <=15% reserve and destination-independent preparation.
Portable baseline, access continuity and separately evidenced transfer phases.
Independent destination intake, resource filtering and source/target firewall.
Separate necessary authorized secret transfer; reuse and safe acquisition first.
Resumable activity and verified context reconstruction after interruption.
Durable significant decisions, rationale and related work.
Actual human-only dependency and automatic verified resumption.
Physical-world responsibilities, constraints and observable completion.
Risk-proportionate consistency checks and semantic compilation.
Controlled application, risk gates, compensation and drift.
Causal, non-fabricated temporal reconstruction with evidence reuse.
Tool-independent external projections over canonical English state.
Maintainer-only release acceptance, regression, traceability and authorized publication.
Current available action context, selective rehydration and retirement.
Conversation and per-message gates plus progressive minimum context.
Full listed BOOT procedure with stable step identities, system obligations, scoped attestation and user communication.
Same-contract delegates, owned controls and validated completion.
